source: De Doncker, R.W.A.A., Divan, D.M., Kheraluwala, M.H. (1991). A three-phase soft-switched high power density DC/DC converter for high power applications. IEEE Trans. Ind. Appl., 27(1), 63-73. L_s.note: Series inductance (transformer leakage + external) 5 uH — the DAB power-transfer element

R_load.note: Nominal resistive load on output bus (200V/4ohm = 10kW)

R_ds_on.note: MOSFET Rds_on per device at T_ref (20 mohm)

R_xfmr.note: Transformer + inductor total winding resistance (50 mohm), referred to primary

alpha_rds.note: MOSFET Rds_on positive tempco (used for nominal Tj=100C derate)

T_j.note: Assumed steady junction temperature for averaged-loss model
